sub_sector.value: end-of-life life insurance; funeral and cemetery services; residential mortgage lending

financial_business_type.detail: Life insurer (preneed, final expense) plus mortgage originator; also funeral homes and cemeteries.

revenue_driver.detail: Insurance premiums and investment income; mortgage origination fees; funeral and cemetery service sales.

customer_type.detail: Individuals and families buying end-of-life insurance, funeral services and home mortgages.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Insurer carries underwriting and investment risk; mortgage and funeral operations are more fee- and service-based.
